title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, delivering enhanced capabilities to help you gain valuable new perspectives.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the visual display of all your embedded files directly within the editor for greater content control.

title: Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap page offers complete transparency into our recently shipped features, exciting upcoming releases, and ambitious future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes to be more clickable, draggable, and visually stunning, making your workflow smoother and more efficient.

title: Enhanced Real-Time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly improved the editor to provide a more seamless and intuitive real-time collaboration experience, making it easier for teams to work together effectively.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Features
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared items with friends, making teamwork more intuitive and productive than ever before.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce robust support for international languages, connecting more users globally.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko's core is now open source, empowering our community with greater control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's evolution.

title: Supercharge Your Knowledge Map
summary: Gain deeper insights into your knowledge base by applying powerful new filters for tags, time, and shared content, transforming your overview into an indispensable workflow tool.

title: Powerful Search & Personalized Knowledge Views
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your most relevant information with a redesigned search experience featuring advanced filtering, sorting, and the ability to save custom knowledge views.

title: Flexible Note Views for Deeper Insights
summary: Seamlessly organize your knowledge with dynamic new layouts that make viewing and interacting with your connected notes more intuitive and powerful.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting and Flexible Subscription Plans
summary: Experience ultimate flexibility with Noeko's new self-hosting capability and explore robust subscription plans built to scale with your organization.

title: Unleash a Spectrum of Stunning New Themes
summary: We're launching an array of stunning new themes and enhancing our current options, allowing you to beautifully customize your Noeko environment like never before.

title: Smarter, Time-Sensitive Greetings
summary: We're making sure your homepage greeting always accurately reflects the time of day wherever you are, providing a more precise and welcoming experience.

title: Enhanced Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage your content by directly unapplying tags and performing other bulk actions from the tag view, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Unlock a World of Content with Expanded Sources
summary: Easily bring all your valuable information into one place by supporting new content types such as YouTube videos, websites, and text files, enhancing your research and learning experience.
